triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: It was he, not my brother, killed our father.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Mitya stood up and greedily looked at his brother and listened to him with a wild, strange smile.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: He hated me at that time, because he had behaved contemptibly and was running after that creature ... and because he owed me that three thousand....

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Why, this,” Ivan suddenly pulled out a roll of notes. “Here’s the money ... the notes that lay in that envelope”

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Here is a document, a letter ... take it, read it quickly, quickly! It’s a letter from that monster ... that man there, there!

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: I looked into your eyes and I knew that you were dishonoring me, and yet I took your money.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: It was he killed his father, you will see that directly. He wrote to me how he would kill his father!

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: It was he, not my brother, killed our father. He murdered him and I incited him to do it

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: how Ivan had been nearly driven out of his mind during the last two months trying to save “the monster and murderer,” his brother.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: We’ve hated each other for many things, Katya, but I swear, I swear I loved you even while I hated you, and you didn’t love me!

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: I swear, I swear I loved you even while I hated you, and you didn’t love me!

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: He wanted to repay it me. He wanted to, that’s true; but he needed money for that creature, too.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: So he murdered his father, but he didn’t repay me, and went off with her to that village where he was arrested.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: If it was not my brother, but Smerdyakov committed the murder’ (for the legend was circulating everywhere that Smerdyakov had done it)

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Then I brought out that letter and showed it him.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Katerina Ivanovna pointed out to the court with venomous and malignant triumph.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: They asked Mitya whether he admitted having written the letter.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: At that moment Grushenka, with a wail, rushed towards Mitya before they had time to prevent her.

triples.subject: Ippolit Kirillovitch
triples.quote: President returned to his seat and our prosecutor, Ippolit Kirillovitch, began his speech.

triples.subject: Fetyukovitch
triples.quote: Fetyukovitch was obviously shaken by Katerina Ivanovna’s evidence.
